proposed_widenings.name: water_breathing
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's underwater-breathing rider is a distinct deterministic capability that the current verification pipeline cannot trace end-to-end.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While wearing this cloak, you can breathe underwater, and you have a Swim Speed of 60 feet.

notes: The item fits magic_item + passive in principle, using grant_speed for the swim-speed rider. I did not keep authored content files because pnpm typecheck fails in tracer exhaustiveness on the existing water_breathing EffectAtom, so no clean trace could be produced.
